'''Mark Bordenet''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 77 from Fairmont, WV. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115121600/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/yavin4.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). |}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
